## Summary

Describe what changes and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Build/tests pass with warnings treated as errors.
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, tokens or restricted SDK material are committed.
- [ ] New dependencies are pinned to immutable revisions.
- [ ] License/redistribution policy was checked for new source/runtime/model assets.
- [ ] `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` was updated if required.
- [ ] Manager-owned downloads use integrity verification.
- [ ] No hidden/duplicate component installer was added outside **Downloads**.
- [ ] Downloads over 1 GiB total package size require explicit user approval.
- [ ] Offline behavior after installation is preserved/documented.
- [ ] New user-visible text is available in English and French.
- [ ] New network hosts/behaviors are documented in `docs/NETWORK_OFFLINE_PRIVACY_POLICY.md`.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.

## Distribution class

Select the applicable class for new dependencies/assets:

- [ ] Source-vendored
- [ ] Manager-owned release asset
- [ ] Restricted local build input
- [ ] Manual-license/gated model
- [ ] External-link/prerequisite
- [ ] Not applicable
